items.title: Roland Hanna interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe and I am very, very pleased to have Sir Roland Hanna here as my guest. [INTERVIEWEE] It’s my pleasure, Monk. Thank you for inviting me.

ctx.x: Roland Hanna was the guest of honor at the Paradise Valley Jazz Party in Scottsdale, Arizona. He was interviewed there on April 15, 2000, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
We are filming in Scottsdale, Arizona at the Paradise Valley Jazz Party. My name is Monk Rowe and I am very, very pleased to have Sir Roland Hanna here as my guest.
It’s my pleasure, Monk. Thank you for inviting me.
